plainTranslation: With Composite Uranus in the 1st house, this can be a relationship that requires you to be on your heels constantly. You can experience a lot of changes and instability in the relationship and with the other person involved. If you can adapt and enjoy the change, you can get through it, but if you want stability, this may not be the relationship you get that from. You also need to allow one another to fully express yourselves. You may seem different in this relationship than in others.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
